# Agent Board / 智能体看板

**Agent Board / 智能体看板** — a DeepSeek Harness UI plugin that renders the current
session's agents as

a live two-column card board in the right sidebar: the main
agent on top, every sub-agent below it i

n creation-time order. It is a standard
DSH bundle (`dsh.bundle`, bundle id `dsh-agent-board`) with

a Web Client half and
no build step.
**中文简介**：在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧边栏中以两列卡片实时展示当前会话的主/子智能体：主 agent 在最上方，子 agent 按创建时间往下排；每个卡片显示状态、计划进度、To
eepSeek Harness 右侧边栏中以两列卡片实时展示当前会话的主/子智能体：主 agent 在最上方，子 agent 按创建时间往下排；每个卡片显示状态、计划进度、Token、费用和运行时间。
Each agent is a compact card ("小方块") with a minimal 1px outline:

- the task it owns (the delegation label, or the session title when no label exists),
- an agent lab

el on the left of the status row: `我` on the main agent's card,
and a short Greek-god / modern-scien

tist name (`宙斯`, `牛顿`, `居里`, …) on
every sub-agent card,
- a status tag beside it — `RUN` with a bli

nking dot, `WAIT`, `DONE`, `IDLE`,
`FAIL`, or `EXT` for an external task,
- a static progress bar ba

sed on its todo plan (no flowing animation),
- a footer with current tokens, USD cost, and live dura

n its todo plan (no flowing animation),
- a footer with current tokens, USD cost, and live duration.

The session you are viewing keeps a thin blue outline; there is no separate
"current" badge any more

. When the current session is itself a subagent, the
chart walks up to the topmost available parent,

so the main agent is always the
first card on screen.
## Install
Install straight from GitHub (no npm package needed):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

On **DSH Desktop**, open the sidebar **Plugins** page → **Add plugin** (or
**Install a third-party p

lugin**) and paste `github:Denis-Tang/dsh-agent-board`
(the desktop app owns its profile, so the CLI

does not change the running app's
profile). After installation the plugin appears in the right side

bar's `+`
guide; reload the page if the new tab does not show up immediately.

The plugin is also being prepared for the
dsh-market catalog through
`awesome-dsh-plugin`.
Once the

catalog entry is live, search **Agent Board / 智能体看板** in
**Plugins → Plugin Market**.

Repository: Denis-Tang/dsh-agent-board.
Requires DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3.0`; this indepe

ndent build is
version `1.0.0`.
## Screenshots
## Where it appears
The view lives in the **right sidebar**:

- The right sidebar's `+` guide lists an **Agent Board** capsule, so the tab can
be opened from ther

e.
- The sidebar tab is a native `sidebar.right.pane.tab` body with a compact
layout, and it stays o
pen beside the chat while the session changes.

The sidebar is **not** opened automatically for an ordinary session. It opens
when you pick the caps

ule from the sidebar `+` guide. While a session is on
screen, **every newly created sub-agent pops t

he sidebar open** and focuses the
Agent Board tab (expanding the column if it is collapsed), so the

new branch
shows up without a manual click. Agents that already exist when the page mounts
do not tr
igger it, and a new agent only announces itself once.
### Layouts

The view opens in **Chart** layout: a strict two-column card grid on the
Hermes-blue paper canvas. T

he main agent's card owns the first row on its own;
every sub-agent (whatever its depth) then fills

two-card rows below it, ordered
by creation time, so reading top to bottom is reading the delegation

timeline.
A paper-white (warm off-white) bus leaves the bottom of the main card and
branches into e

very sub-agent card, which keeps the main-to-sub relationship
visible without drawing
a full tree th

at the time order would contradict. New agents append at the end,
so existing cards never jump aroun

the time order would contradict. New agents append at the end,
so existing cards never jump around.

The panel is never wider than its content needs: the card width follows the
measured panel width, so

a wide sidebar panel shows two roomy columns while the
default right sidebar keeps exactly two narr

ow ones. Cards keep a fixed aspect
ratio: the column width picks a single scale factor and the whole

card — text,
padding, borders and progress bar included — is scaled uniformly by it, so a
wider pan

el produces proportionally bigger cards instead of only flatter ones.
The card scale is clamped to t

he sidebar range (about 0.7×–1.9×); when the chart
is taller than the panel it is scaled down as a w

hole (auto-fit can reach 30%,
manual wheel zoom stays at 35%–250%) so all cards stay in view; use th

e mouse
wheel to zoom around the cursor and double-click the background to reset pan and
zoom. Each

card is three rows: the status row (agent label first,
then the status tag with its blinking dot) at

the top, the left-aligned title in
a deeper blue vertically centred in the middle, and the progress

bar pinned to
the bottom edge (hover swaps it for tokens, cost, and runtime). All three rows
share

the card's content-box left edge, so the label, the title and the progress
bar start on the same ver

content-box left edge, so the label, the title and the progress
bar start on the same vertical line.

The paper/particle-cloud artwork is a full-panel layer: it runs behind the
header, the wordmark and

every card, with the same breathing margin on all four
sides. The blue `AGENT BOARD` wordmark floats

on the cloud (with a soft paper

## Compatibility

Built and tested against DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.3`. The package declares
`engines.dsh: >=0.2.1-r

c.1 <0.3.0`.
It depends only on the Web Client slot surface and the standard session hooks:

- `sidebar.right.pane.tab` slot with `sessionId`, `useSessions`, `useSessionStatus`,
`useProjection(

'todos')` (optional, falls back to the projection store)
- `ctx.sidebarRightTabs.register` (tab type

) and `ctx.get('sidebarRight')` (open/focus)
- `conversation.session.header.utilities` (invisible he

lper that opens the tab when a sub-agent is created)
- `ctx.sessions.refreshProjections`
- `ctx.uiWo

rkspace.openSession`
- `ctx.locale` and `ctx.slots`

No Harness Client package is imported as a module; React comes from the browser
module table.
